resources.string: Online profile credentials, cached games and marks are encrypted on this device. The app excludes its data from Android backup and device transfer. Older offline saves remain on this device and can be removed in Settings.

The service stores your nickname, avatar, tickets, calls, results, coin balance and transaction records. Other players see names, avatars and wins, and only their own ticket numbers. Practice personas are simulated and labelled. Coins are free game currency with no cash value.

Rooms close 24 hours after creation. Their game records are scheduled for removal 30 days after expiry. Profiles with an enabled device credential and their coin wallets have no automatic expiry. Seven-day game sessions renew on this installation without changing your wallet. Unenrolled or revoked profiles are scheduled for removal 30 days after session expiry. Local cached results remain until reset, profile deletion or replacement by newer results. Backup recovery records have a separate lifetime, explained below.

Deletion removes your profile and access, leaves every room, and replaces your profile name and avatar in service game records with Deleted player. Other players can finish an active game. Shared tickets, calls, scores, prize titles and results remain until room retention expires. Text you entered into prize titles and copies already saved or shared by others are not removed. After confirmation, this device clears its online data and badges. Offline rounds stay.

Signing out or deleting a profile does not erase older backups. The service separately records a random profile ID and the time of sign-out or deletion so an older backup cannot restore access. Deletion also retains a one-way confirmation code and its expiry. These recovery records contain no display name, avatar or sign-in secret and currently have no automatic expiry. The same deletion request can confirm its result for 30 days; recovery protection remains after that confirmation expires.

Signing out revokes both the session and device credential and clears online data on this device; it does not immediately delete service history. Reset only clears this device. Resetting, uninstalling or losing this device can lose access to your wallet; there is currently no account recovery on another installation. Use Delete online profile to remove service data. If deletion awaits confirmation, keep its saved request and use Retry pending action. Resetting discards that confirmation proof.

There are no cash purchases. Configured builds offer optional rewarded videos through Google AdMob; ad privacy choices appear when required. Google’s ad SDK may process device identifiers and network information according to your device and ad privacy choices. We do not send your name, tickets, room code or profile ID to AdMob. A random reward reference links a completed video to server-verified coins. Optional Firebase diagnostics are off until you enable sharing. Number voices were generated with OpenAI and play from packaged recordings; gameplay does not send game data to OpenAI. The service stores only hashes of session and device credentials. It keeps short-lived request-limit records and aggregate health counts and timings. Those metrics contain no names, room codes, tickets or profile IDs.
